summary: These are GOALS as the owner has set them — never present them as accomplished facts. NEAR-TERM: (1) Ship the parked production release — a run of audited, tested, merged work (agent-context repairs, campaign editing restoration, public-facing discretion layer, AI video generation, image-lettering fix; PRs #402-#406) is merged to main awaiting the owner's release go; production still runs the previous build. (2) Run the AI video pilot: Alibaba Model Studio (Wan) free quotas behind a swappable provider adapter, usage tracked per model, generation failing closed at quota end with NO silent paid spillover; the post-pilot decision (paid floor vs off) is the owner's, made with pilot data. (3) Serve the first cohorts of campaign creators and reach first subscriber revenue — the standing business rule: until there is regular monthly income there can be no regular monthly bill; free-tier discipline is a rule, not a preference. Free tiers are acceptable only when non-expiring and sufficient for at least 50 users. (4) Complete payment implementation and review so campaign donations can be enabled deliberately, never by drift. LONG-TERM: one unified fundraising operating system — campaigns, users, donations, AI agents, admin, and shared data in a single ecosystem; AI-powered donor matching; human-directed AI campaign management; official-API connections to external crowdfunding platforms under delegated, revocable authorisation; and agent knowledge that is portable — retained with provenance and permissions independently of any single AI provider. OPEN OWNER DECISIONS on record: the paid floor after the video pilot; whether day-pass members are entitled to AI content credits; hackathon entry choices; every production release go. Full text: executiveagent/docs/IFUND_MASTER_BRIEF.md section (c).
title: Interplanetary Fund — goals, near-term and long-term (goals, not accomplishments)
